name: Correction
about: Correct a record, citation, identity boundary or legal status
title: ''
---

## Record

Record ID or roster slug, file path and the specific field or claim.

## Proposed correction

What is inaccurate, what should replace it, and what remains uncertain?

## Public evidence

Source URL, publisher, publication date, and page, paragraph or timestamp. Quote the exact relevant text when possible.

## Identity and legal status

Explain any effect on identity boundaries, allegations, sanctions, findings or historical context. Do not infer identity from a matching name or handle alone.

Do not include private correspondence, credentials or sensitive personal information in this issue. Use the website contact channel for a private review request.
